title: Modernpvptweaks
description: This is a pvp mod that enhances your gameplay when pvping.
body:
pvptweaks
A Minecraft Fabric mod that enhances PvP gameplay.
It adds 3 main features a crosshair indicator, an armor durability displayer(of your oppenents armor) and a reach display. This is a pvp mod that helps you pvp better. Note that the armor durability setting may not work on servers that have the feature blocked and it may also banned on certain servers. Use at your own risk.  This is not a finished mod and will be added onto later in time. Please let me know of any bugs or wanted changes, I will try to implement them. Currently it only works on one version I am attempting to make it compatitble with other versions.

Features
Custom crosshair hit indicator to indicate when an entity is in range of you

Reach display (displays distance of last hit)

Armor durability HUD (above nametag)

All options can be be toggled on and off

Options are located in minecraft keybinds

Installation

Install Fabric Loader

Put the mod .jar into your mods folder
